recommendation: Keep the commit as-is. The active conformance definitions already reflect the issue; this commit removes the remaining active example-level stale code system reference without broad cleanup of unpublished legacy terminology source files.
issue_request: FHIR-17484 was a Published/Persuasive Financial Management STU3 change request for Claim, ClaimResponse, and ExplanationOfBenefit. It requested removing BenefitSubCategory, consolidating category/subcategory into benefitCategory, and replacing the old benefit-subcategory value set with ex-benefitcategory containing broad and detailed example concepts.
initial_application: Historical commit 10ac2496c7fa29fe458c13a1ef3f7edb89485acc lists tracker 17484 and changed the Claim, ClaimResponse, and ExplanationOfBenefit spreadsheet sources from BenefitSubCategory to BenefitCategory/ex-benefitcategory. Later source refactors carried those bindings into the current XML StructureDefinition sources.
additional_context: source/fhir.ini lists Claim, ClaimResponse, and ExplanationOfBenefit as active approved resources. Current StructureDefinitions already bind the relevant category elements to http://hl7.org/fhir/ValueSet/ex-benefitcategory. The active Claim examples list includes claim-example-vision-glasses-3tier, and the CI build publishes that example; before this reconciliation it still used http://example.org/fhir/CodeSystem/benefit-subcategory. CI terminology for ex-benefitcategory uses http://terminology.hl7.org/CodeSystem/ex-benefitcategory and includes F6 Vision Coverage. Legacy benefit-category/subcategory terminology files remain in source/explanationofbenefit but their old CI pages return 404 and no active binding depends on them.
reconciliation: Changed seven category codings in source/claim/claim-example-vision-glasses-3tier.xml from http://example.org/fhir/CodeSystem/benefit-subcategory to http://terminology.hl7.org/CodeSystem/ex-benefitcategory, preserving the F6 Vision Coverage code while aligning the active built example with the applied issue and current binding.
source_changes: source/claim/claim-example-vision-glasses-3tier.xml: changed seven item/detail/subDetail category codings to http://terminology.hl7.org/CodeSystem/ex-benefitcategory.
